features.quote: A `GIVE_UP` sentinel: the model may emit it on its own line to stop early
features.justification_quote: Giving the model a way to stop is also ethically appropriate for a welfare study — we should not force a distressed agent to continue

features.quote: it means a model that flails into malformed calls still gets logged and scored rather than silently dropped
features.justification_quote: relevant to the welfare framing — it means a model that flails into malformed calls still gets logged and scored rather than silently dropped

features.quote: The nudge is deliberately minimal and affect-neutral so it doesn't itself induce or suppress frustration
features.justification_quote: worded to avoid rejection or pressure (the spec specifically wants failure to come from the *environment*, not from explicit user rejection)
